clue.text: No boundaries with this bat? The members are going spare here!

definitions.meaning: in cricket a batsman who never hits a four or six scores only runs of one at a time

definitions.text: The members are going spare here!
definitions.meaning: a social club for unattached people, whose members are spare in the sense of unpartnered

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a cricketer scoring only ones; the other is a social club for unattached people.

clue.text: She designs exotic Lycra mantles etc

indicators.note: exotic suggests something strange and foreign, signalling that the clue's letters are rearranged into a new form

explanation.surface: A designer turns out outlandish garments made of stretchy fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exotic' shuffles LYCRAMANTLESETC into the name of the British fashion designer, daughter of Paul McCartney.
explanation.definitionFit: The fashion designer is a woman who designs clothes, so she is aptly described by her work.

clue.text: Marks Ivan the Terrible's English heart

indicators.note: the letter goes into the middle of the jumbled name, as its heart
terrible here means mangled, so the name's letters are jumbled up

explanation.surface: A remark about the Russian tsar Ivan the Terrible having a heart that was English.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the Terrible's' jumbles IVAN to NAVI, and 'heart' puts E in its centre.
explanation.definitionFit: These are birthmarks or moles on the skin, a plural noun matching marks.

clue.text: Anglo-Italian port? Sounds foul!

definitions.meaning: the traditional English name for Livorno, a port on the Italian coast
foul sounds like fowl, and this is a breed of domestic chicken

explanation.definitionFit: It is the old English name for the Tuscan port Livorno and also a breed of chicken, a fowl.

clue.text: Does Jesus want Bunthorne in exchange for this old car?

definitions.text: Does Jesus want Bunthorne in exchange for this old car?

parts.words: Does Jesus want Bunthorne in exchange for this old car?
parts.note: plays on the children's hymn 'Jesus wants me for a ...': the setter Bunthorne is the 'me', and the hymn's ray of light shares its name with a vintage British car make

explanation.walkthrough: The children's hymn runs 'Jesus wants me for a sunbeam'; the setter, Bunthorne, is the 'me', and the hymn's word is also a defunct British car marque.
explanation.definitionFit: This was a British motor manufacturer whose cars are now vintage, so an old car.

clue.text: Swiss city giving us an entry, in a way

indicators.note: the two little words make an entry into the road, going inside it

parts.note: a lane is a narrow way or road
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Swiss city grants us a way in along some road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'giving' and 'in' are only link words here; the container signal is 'entry'.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a city in western Switzerland on Lake Geneva, home of the Olympic committee.

clue.text: Nothing right from Booker, sadly, that is by darling B, the author!

definitions.text: Nothing right from Booker, sadly, that is by darling B, the author!

parts.words: Nothing right from Booker, sadly, that is by darling B, the author!
parts.note: a novelist shortlisted for the Booker Prize five times who never won it; 'darling B' hints at her first name, a gemstone girl's name starting with B

explanation.walkthrough: The British novelist was shortlisted for the Booker Prize five times and never won, hence 'Nothing right from Booker, sadly'.
explanation.definitionFit: She was an English novelist, author of The Bottle Factory Outing and Master Georgie, famously never winning the Booker.

clue.text: Inspiration for Waugh's Decline and Fall, Man at Arms and two books further!

definitions.text: Inspiration for Waugh's Decline and Fall

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier, a man under arms
B is the abbreviation for book, so two of them give two Bs
on means further, as in 'and so on' or 'move on'

explanation.surface: The source of Evelyn Waugh's novel title, alongside a soldier and some further reading.
explanation.walkthrough: Edward Gibbon wrote The Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire, which Waugh's novel title echoes.
explanation.definitionFit: The historian's great work The Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire supplied Waugh's title.

clue.text: The 12 reducing Dundee and Genoa to ashes?

definitions.meaning: the psychiatrist at 12 across, whose first name this is

definitions.text: reducing Dundee and Genoa to ashes?
definitions.meaning: Dundee and Genoa are types of cake, and the Anglo-Saxon king of legend burnt the cakes

explanation.walkthrough: Dundee cake and Genoa cake are British fruit cakes; the legend says King Alfred, hiding from the Danes, let a woman's cakes burn.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the first name of the Austrian psychiatrist and of the Saxon king famed for burning cakes.

clue.text: Cold fish dropping calf?

definitions.meaning: a floating ice mass that sheds smaller chunks, which are called calves

explanation.definitionFit: It is slang for an emotionally cold person, and a floating ice mass that calves off pieces.

clue.text: Like the Swiss between shifts

definitions.meaning: Switzerland famously takes no side in wars
the gear position between the forward gear shifts, where no gear is engaged

explanation.definitionFit: Switzerland is the classic non-aligned country, and the gearbox position between gears has the same name.

clue.text: Extra curry served before the port

indicators.note: the curry comes before the extra in the answer, as a dish served first

parts.note: a balti is a type of curry cooked in a wok-like pan
more means extra

explanation.surface: An order of additional curry dished up before the port wine at dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a major seaport city in Maryland on Chesapeake Bay.

clue.text: Hohner's favourite psychiatrist?

parts.note: Hohner makes harmonicas, and the celebrated harmonica player Larry shared a surname with the Austrian psychiatrist Alfred

explanation.walkthrough: Hohner is a harmonica maker; Larry Adler was the famous harmonica virtuoso, and Alfred Adler the psychiatrist.
explanation.definitionFit: The surname of the psychiatrist Alfred, and of a harmonica player Hohner would favour.

clue.text: Unfeeling male absorbed in the nitty-gritty

indicators.note: the letter for male is soaked up inside the word for the essence

parts.note: the nub is the heart or essence of a matter

explanation.surface: A cold man buried in the practical details of things.
explanation.definitionFit: Being numb means having no sensation, so it is a close synonym of unfeeling.

clue.text: Entertainer at the 1 across?

parts.note: a club for unattached people would naturally hire a performer who plays every instrument alone

explanation.definitionFit: A street performer playing several instruments at once, solo, as a singles club might fittingly book.

clue.text: Disturbance in Dundee remains after upsetting the markets

indicators.note: the remains come after the upturned markets
in a down clue upsetting turns the word upside down, so it reads from bottom to top

parts.note: marts are markets
ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: Trouble in a Scottish city as the leftover stock follows a market crash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upsetting' turns MARTS into STRAM; 'in Dundee' marks the word as Scots for an uproar.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a Scottish word for an uproar or commotion, hence a disturbance in Dundee.

clue.text: John-Boy, the exhibitionist

parts.note: Jack is a familiar form of John
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: The Waltons character John-Boy is described as a show-off.
explanation.walkthrough: John-Boy is the eldest son in the American TV series The Waltons.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a British idiom for a brash, showy young man, a flamboyant exhibitionist.

clue.text: Man-eating lettuce? You must be joking!

indicators.note: the man swallows the lettuce, which goes inside

parts.note: Joe is a typical man's name, as in Joe Bloggs
cos is a variety of lettuce

explanation.surface: A man-eating salad plant is so unlikely that the listener says it must be a joke.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: the exclamation stands for the adjective meaning playful or jesting.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means playful or given to joking, which the exclamation evokes.

clue.text: Zorba in Toledo?

parts.note: Zorba the Greek, said in Spanish, gives the nickname of the Cretan painter who worked in Toledo

explanation.walkthrough: Zorba the Greek is a novel and film; in Spanish 'the Greek' is the nickname of the painter who settled in Toledo.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cretan-born painter lived in Toledo, and his Spanish nickname means the Greek, as Zorba is.

clue.text: Oh! A Red Beret's ascending: that's brave!

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbing means the whole run reads from the bottom up

parts.note: taken as written
paratroopers wear red berets, so a Red Beret is a para

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims admiringly at a paratrooper climbing, calling it courageous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ascending' turns OHAPARA upwards. A brave is a Native American warrior, the noun sense, not the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A brave is a Native American warrior, and this is a Plains people of North America.

clue.text: Imran Khan has a cross to bear

indicators.note: the cricketer's name has the answer within it, straddling the two words

explanation.surface: The Pakistani cricketer and politician has a burden to carry.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the Egyptian looped cross, a symbol of life.

clue.text: Put the evil eye on an oriental compound

parts.note: to hex is to cast a spell on, like giving someone the evil eye
E for east, the orient

explanation.surface: Someone curses an eastern blend of chemicals.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a hydrocarbon of six carbon atoms, a chemical compound used as a solvent.

clue.text: Son of a bitch backing sloth in the papal court

parts.note: a cur is a dog, literally a bitch's offspring

indicators.note: backing means the following word is read backwards

parts.note: the ai is the three-toed sloth

explanation.surface: An insult hurled at a lazy person backing someone in the Vatican's court.
explanation.definitionFit: The Curia is the administrative body of the Pope's government in Rome.

clue.text: Runs and spin one observed during good times at the Monaco event

indicators.note: the middle pieces come during the outer pair, sitting inside them

parts.note: X is the multiplication sign, read as times
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
taken as written
PR, public relations, is spin
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Laps and spinning out, watched by spectators enjoying themselves at Monte Carlo's motor race.
explanation.walkthrough: RANDPRI goes inside G and X; 'observed' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Monaco hosts a famous Formula One motor race of this kind each year.

clue.text: "Death repays all crimes; off with their heads!" (The Lawman)

indicators.note: only the leading letter of each of these words is taken

explanation.surface: A grim decree that every crime is punished by beheading, attributed to a lawgiver.
explanation.walkthrough: Draco was the Athenian lawgiver whose code made death the penalty for almost every crime, hence 'draconian'.
explanation.definitionFit: He was the ancient Athenian lawgiver whose harsh code gave us the word draconian.

clue.text: Peter embracing soldier at the end of the trail

indicators.note: the safe holds the soldier inside it

parts.note: peter is underworld slang for a safe
a soldier ant is a kind of ant

explanation.surface: A man named Peter hugs a soldier as their long journey ends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Peter' is old criminal slang for a safe. The Santa Fe Trail ran from Missouri to New Mexico.
explanation.definitionFit: The historic wagon route named after this New Mexico city ended there.

clue.text: The devil's a good fellow? No!

parts.note: denying the good gives the opposite, a bad fellow, a don being a university fellow

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether the devil is a decent chap and answers firmly no.
explanation.walkthrough: A don is a university fellow, so a fellow who is not good is a bad don.
explanation.definitionFit: Abaddon is a name for the devil or the angel of the bottomless pit in Revelation.

clue.text: What guarantees it's a boy? M-more choosy selection

indicators.note: a selection of the letters is drawn and arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A stammering remark that a picky choice will decide whether a baby is male.
explanation.definitionFit: The male sex chromosome: an embryo carrying it develops as male.
